title: Warm Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Turkish dish featuring lamb, vanilla bean paste, and miso marinade, served in individual mini cocottes. This keto friendly recipe is perfect for a nostalgic and flavorful dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, vanilla bean paste, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, if desired.
Place the lamb skewers or cubes into individual mini cocottes.
Bake the lamb in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the lamb from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve the warm Turkish lamb kebabs hot, straight from the mini cocottes.
